title: Demonic Portal Guardians
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a blue horned demon in ornate dark robes standing in the foreground left, a golden eastern dragon coiled across the center, and a bandaged mummy-like figure with exposed teeth on the right. In the background a tall horned figure with a staff stands before a massive demonic stone archway under a purple and yellow starry sky.
prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy scene with a glowing blue-skinned horned demon in ornate black and gold robes standing in the left foreground, a massive golden eastern dragon with glowing scales coiled through the center, and a horrifying bandaged mummy with visible teeth and wrappings on the right. Behind them a tall horned shadowy figure holds a staff before a giant demonic stone archway carved with monstrous faces, set against a swirling purple and yellow cosmic sky with stars.
